question: What is the minimum age for employment in factories or mines or other hazardous employment, according to Article 24 of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is __14 years****.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Article 24 of the Indian Constitution prohibits the employment of children below the age of 14 years in factories, mines, or other hazardous occupations.
 
• The provision safeguards children from exploitation and hazardous work environments.
 
• This is part of the broader fundamental rights enshrined in the Constitution to protect children.
 
• The aim is to ensure their safety, health, and development.

**Additional Information__**

 
• **Child Labour Prohibition:**
 
 
• The Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act 1986 prohibits the employment of children below 14 years in certain occupations and processes.
 
• It regulates the working conditions of children in non-hazardous occupations.
 
 
 
• **Exceptions:**
 
 
• Children are allowed to work in family enterprises or as child artists, provided it does not affect their education.
 
• This is to ensure a balance between cultural practices and child welfare.
 
 
 
• **Global Standards:**
 
 
• India is a signatory to the International Labour Organization (ILO) conventions on child labour.
 
• These conventions aim to eliminate the worst forms of child labour worldwide.
